claim_one_line: THE PARAMETER-CLOSURE LOOP, RUN 1 (owner-directed masterplan; 9 agents, ~686k subagent tokens, 20 min). THE SCORE, in the adjudicator's own words: ZERO ROWS DELETED, ONE GATE WRITTEN, ONE REGRESSION, ONE REFUTATION. The pre-registration was WRONG AND INSTRUCTIVELY SO: this bench predicted C3 and C1 could close while C2 and C4 could only sharpen; in fact C1 closed NEGATIVELY and ENLARGED ITS OWN ROW, C3 did NOT close, C2 FAILED adversarial review, and C4 delivered exactly as predicted -- so the cell predicted least likely to move is the only one that did. (1) THE FINDING THAT MATTERS MOST IS A VACUITY IN OUR OWN RECORD: the C1 verifier asked that a clause be STRUCK for want of a computation; the adjudicator RAN the computation instead and the outcome was worse than striking. B1192/GC-16's supporting clause ('X0 acts as the Galois generator on BOTH spectral fields, so the class restricts to c') is MB12-VACUOUS, re-derived here: for hyperbolic P in SL2(Z) the eigenvalues are {lam, 1/lam} and the Galois conjugate of lam over Q(tr P) IS 1/lam, so ANY X with XPX^-1 = P^-1 carries P's lam-eigenline to P^-1's lam-eigenline = P's OWN 1/lam-eigenline -- EVERY anti-conjugator swaps them, BY CONSTRUCTION, and this bench exhibits it for a det X = +1 anti-conjugator, the mirror-EVEN type the record calls dead. The clause has NO FAILING BRANCH and supports nothing; the det = -1 SIGN result is untouched. THIS IS THE SECOND MB12-VACUITY IN A FORTNIGHT (after B1206 candidate iii) AND BOTH WERE IN SUPPORTING CLAUSES RATHER THAN HEADLINES -- the headline claims are getting checked, the sentences propping them up are not. (2) C1 REFUTES THE MASTERPLAN'S OWN CLOSURE ROUTE for the c-bit: the sqrt(3)-partner is NOT canonical at TWO levels -- norm-+1 holds for 30 of 37 real quadratic fields scanned (81%, generic not fine-tuned), and PREVIOUSLY UNFLAGGED, even fixing the same field (disc 12) conjugating the partner within its own GL2(Z)-class changes the outcome (22/60 DIRECT(det=-1) vs 38 TORSOR with no integral realizer at all). THE COUNTEREXAMPLE THAT KILLS THE CRITERION: DIRECT(-1) is exhibited for disc 13, a genuine NORM-(-1) field (fundamental unit 18+5sqrt13) of the same self-coupling-killed type as the golden -- so norm+1 is NOT NECESSARY once embedding freedom is admitted (also disc 21, disc 15). THE CONTROL keeps it honest: a 204-embedding scan of the norm-(-1) sqrt(2) control gives only DIRECT(+1) or TORSOR, NEVER DIRECT(-1), so the achievable sign IS field-specific but DOES NOT TRACK the unit-norm dichotomy GC-2/GC-16 proposed. (3) C3 DID NOT CLOSE THE P^3 but reduced it to ONE BINARY LOOKUP WITH BOTH BRANCHES PROVED: do the SU(5) components feeding the down leg and the lepton leg carry the SAME Z/12 characters? SAME => det Y_e IDENTICALLY EQUALS det Y_d (transpose-invariance) => zero new cut, dim 1 WITH CERTAINTY; DIFFERENT => an independent cubic => dim 0. AND IT CORRECTED B1215: my tail enumeration missed (8,8), which also satisfies 16 = 4 mod 12 -- it is likewise a repeated direction and also dies by skewness, so the corrected count is 2 surviving (down) vs 1 (lepton); B1215's CONCLUSION stands, its enumeration did not. (4) C2 WAS REFUTED BY ITS OWN VERIFIER AND THE REFUTATION IS CORRECT: it claimed a theorem-shaped {II_1, III_1} exhaustion while its sources say otherwise verbatim (B850: 'Type: III_1 -- CONDITIONAL on the cited reduction'; B721: 'There IS a genuine bridge IN THE LITERATURE') -- citations presented as 'confirmed two independent ways'. WHAT SURVIVES: Q(sqrt-3) has UNIT RANK 0 so its regulator is IDENTICALLY 1, killing that sub-route by textbook fact, and B721's Delta = I is a real in-sandbox number (4.59e-41). WHAT IS WITHDRAWN: the exhaustion and the 'excluded by TYPE' argument. LAMBDA IS NOW WORSE-DOCUMENTED THAN BEFORE THE RUN. (5) C4 IS THE ONLY FORWARD MOTION: sigma moves from 'one bridge missing, unspecified' to 'one bridge missing, FULLY SPECIFIED, with a runnable pass/fail test and a documented EMPTY candidate set' -- the missing object named (the graded character chi_d of the AdS3-boundary chiral algebra of T[m004] at c = 6) with a six-clause kind-map K1-K6 including the Cardy 6-vs-1 quantifier (the object supplies ONE cusp-boson unit; a candidate must say where the other FIVE live), and B672's coefficients re-derived from scratch confirming K3's failure is genuine with a NON-EMPTY pass-branch. (6) GOAL TEST: NO. sigma PASSES the second disjunct (bounded, gated, testable, not derived); LAMBDA BLOCKS (no acceptance gate exists at all); THE P^3 BLOCKS (bounded to an internal computable fact this bench does not hold -- one lookup away is not closed); l is correctly typed as a permanent boundary and out of scope. (7) THE REPLAN R1-R6, with ONE CAVEAT RECORDED IN ADVANCE: dim 0 IS A FINITE POINT SET, so if the P^3 closes the row converts from continuous to FINITE LABEL and joins B990's already-closed category -- IT DOES NOT BECOME A UNIQUE PREDICTION, and anyone quoting a future closure must quote that sentence with it. Gate 5 clean.
